name: deploy-comfyui-amd-windows
description: Guided, evidence-based ComfyUI deployment for AMD Radeon GPUs on Windows.

interface.displayName: Community Setup for ComfyUI on AMD Windows
interface.shortDescription: Inspect, plan, deploy, and verify ComfyUI on AMD Windows systems.
interface.longDescription: Guides Radeon users from read-only hardware, storage, and page-file inspection through an evidence-based ROCm route, verified installation, real inference, and desktop launchers. Includes a standalone Windows GUI wizard that does not require a coding agent.
defaultPrompt: Use $deploy-comfyui-amd-windows to inspect this AMD Windows PC and propose a safe ComfyUI deployment.
Use $deploy-comfyui-amd-windows to repair an existing AMD ROCm ComfyUI installation.
Use $deploy-comfyui-amd-windows to check AMD compatibility without installing anything.
